_meta.description: Heart event #5 for npc_michelle: The Greenhouse

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [You've built Michelle a proper greenhouse. She's seeing it for the first time]

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: The glass panels... the heating system... you spent DAYS on this.

options.text: Your herbs deserve a proper home.
You deserve something built just for you.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: No one has ever... done something like this for me.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: Not because I asked. Not because they had to.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: Just because they wanted me to be happy.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: I'm going to cry now. In my beautiful new greenhouse. And I'm not sorry.
